note: Triennial election of the 16 electoral divisions of Clogher rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. There was no contest and no change in the composition of the council: eleven Unionists and five Nationalists were returned unopposed, including five new members. The report does not give a party label for each division. Printed as 'Keady, Fivemiletown, Dr. H. R. Nelson'. Returned unopposed. The returning officer's notice names him Herbert Nelson.
